cases.condition: phonopy version is not exact 4.3.1 or the requested stage has no versioned profile
cases.minimum_next_action: Add exact official semantics, profile, and fixtures for the requested version or stage.

cases.condition: unit-cell or primitive identity, atom count, or primitive matrix is missing or inconsistent
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebuild the manifest with separate unit-cell and primitive identities and a nonsingular primitive matrix.

cases.condition: supercell matrix is not integer nonsingular 3 by 3 or its determinant does not close atom count
cases.minimum_next_action: Correct the supercell matrix or atom count and regenerate all downstream identities.

cases.condition: displacement ids or structure hashes duplicate, atom index is out of range, or vector norm differs from the declared distance
cases.minimum_next_action: Regenerate the displacement set from the same validated unit and supercell identities.

cases.condition: displacement and force records are not exactly one to one
cases.minimum_next_action: Provide exactly one evidenced force record for every displacement and remove extras.

cases.condition: force unit or shape differs, a parent acceptance gate is not pass, or raw parent hash and semantic projection detach
cases.minimum_next_action: Repair the upstream calculation evidence and rebuild its projection from the same raw parent record.

cases.condition: canonical ordered force-collection hash differs from the manifest
cases.minimum_next_action: Sort by displacement id and recompute the collection hash from the specified canonical preimage.

cases.condition: force-constant shape or either displacement and force-collection parent is inconsistent
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebuild force constants from the same validated displacement and force collection.

cases.condition: mesh, band, DOS, or NAC product binds to a different force-constant parent or DOS binds to a different mesh
cases.minimum_next_action: Select artifacts from one lineage and never join products by filename.

cases.condition: frequency artifact bytes, unit, 3N modes, dimensions, signed values, or declared q path are inconsistent
cases.minimum_next_action: Parse the original bound artifact with matching explicit unit, dimensions, and q-path parameters.

cases.condition: NAC tensor shape, primitive identity, response acceptance, unit convention, or raw source projection is inconsistent
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebuild NAC evidence from an accepted response record for the same primitive identity.

cases.condition: output exists, aliases an input, or durable temporary write and atomic publish fails
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve all inputs and old targets, repair storage, and rerun with a new absent output path.

cases.condition: native Phonopy execution is requested but no exact 4.3.1 executable or Python distribution identity is available
cases.minimum_next_action: Keep the request documentation-only until exact 4.3.1 package and entrypoint identity are available.

cases.condition: a plan uses the pre-v4 setup or collection route, phonopy-load as a current primary command, main-CLI --nac, or another option absent from the pinned 4.3.1 parser
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebuild the plan with phonopy-init for setup or force collection and phonopy for YAML calculations using only pinned 4.3.1 options.

cases.condition: the requested capability has no established recipe or a documented command conflicts with the pinned 4.3.1 entrypoint parser
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve the exact installed parser and official source conflict or add a version-safe recipe before generating a command.

cases.condition: all requested candidate gates pass, including signed-frequency preservation
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the candidate report without authorizing execution or promotion and perform post-promotion scientific review separately.

cases.condition: No earlier case can be established from the available exact evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop and obtain the exact evidence needed to select one earlier Phonopy case.
